input.title: ZM Beta Player Messages - Team Note (Oct 1 2025)
input.bodyText:
ZM Beta Player Messages: what we actually say to players

Sources: PNs Beta tab, DES-314 asks plus DES-313, Beta message rule, NotificationManager.cs on main, backend schedules, and Vincent's Phone message checks plus his later corrections. The full call list is in the "ZM Beta Player Messages - Calls" sheet in the same folder.

1) Retention: Sep 15 cohort week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION)
- iOS: 237 installs. D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs. D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%

2) Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day
These are scheduled locally when the app goes to background. They only go out once our own permission ask has run (after level 20) or the player has switched notifications on in settings.
- Day 1: "The Horde Is Growing… 🧟‍♂️" (Lapsed 1 day). Go.
- Day 7: "They've Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱" (Lapsed 7 days). Go. The headline changes to "Your Squad Is Waiting" (DES-346).
- Day 14, Day 21 and Day 28: the same 7-day message again. The weekly batch repeats for 4 weeks, which is why the Lapsed 14 days ask is a Drop.
- Nothing on day 2-6, nothing between the weekly repeats, and nothing after day 28. That means day 3 (DES-342) and day 30 (DES-343) are Holds: not scheduled yet.

3) Already scheduled by the client but still a Hold, and why
- Lives recharged ("Full Ammo Reloaded!", DES-315). Test 6: it isn't seen on both platforms. On Sep 30 it didn't arrive on the iOS 0.3.49 store build after a full refill, tried twice, and Vincent took his tick off.
- Finish first mission (DES-318). Test 4: it can't reach its audience. It is only scheduled for players below level 20, but our permission ask runs after level 20, so nobody it's written for has had our ask. The settings toggle doesn't count.
- Plague Race (DES-319). Test 6: not seen on iOS. Vincent's iOS tick was on the 5-minute-timer build, and the real iOS 0.3.40 store build never showed it. Android is fine. The daily timing is fine because there's always a race on.
- Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320). Test 5: it fires on the wrong day. The client schedules it 7, 14, 21 and 28 days after the last session, but leagues reset Mondays 00:00 UTC. It only lands on reset day if the player last played on a Monday.

4) Counts
32 messages in total: 14 PNs Beta rows (Win & Collect is DES-313) plus 18 asks. Go 2, Hold 24, Drop 6.
- Go: Lapsed 1 day and Lapsed 7 days. Both are on the Push Notifications card checklist for Vincent.
- Drop: Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever and Axe Arena (none of them is in the beta), Comeback gift (a v2 idea), and Lapsed 14 days (already covered by Lapsed 7 days).
- Hold tickets go to Backlog, unassigned, per the BETA "Fix TECH ISSUES" card. Most Holds just need a local timer added in NotificationManager (test 3). Five need a server send (test 2): Endless weekly result, Season Pass premium nudge, Plague Race result, Support reply waiting, New levels added.

Note: neither status column on the PN sheet decided anything here. The sheet marks six rows Ready, and only the two lapsed ones pass all six tests.

- DES-345 Comeback gift on tap: Drop. A reward on tap is a v2 idea and isn't in the beta (test 1). Moved to Canceled.

Held tickets sit in Backlog, unassigned, until the beta build is out (per the BETA "Fix TECH ISSUES" card). The full list of calls is in my Drive: "ZM Beta Player Messages - Calls (Oct 1 2025)".

Thanks,
Samuel
